name: Gaussian Splat Chunk Compression with Morton Reordering
definition: A technique to reduce Gaussian Splatting data size by reordering splats into spatially local chunks, normalizing data within chunks to 0..1 range, and storing them in GPU textures with compression formats.
summary: Gaussian Splat Chunk Compression with Morton Reordering reduces 3D Gaussian Splatting model size by reordering splats into spatially local chunks and normalizing data to align with GPU texture compression block structures.
